name: WHA Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: WHA Corporation Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops, rents, and sells lands, buildings, factories, warehouses, and other properties in Thailand and internationally. It also develops and manages properties in industrial estates and zones. In addition, the company provides digital, data center, Internet connection, and other IT services; and public utilities, facilities, and other related services. Further, it is involved in the water utility and power, mobility, and logistics businesses. WHA Corporation Public Company Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Samut Prakan, Thailand.
